priorityList: Cast Arcane Intellect and Mirror Image before entering combat.
Use Evocation if mana is below 10% and Arcane Surge is not active to recover resources.
Cast Arcane Surge on cooldown to initiate your primary burn phase.
Cast Touch of the Magi while Arcane Surge is active, or whenever available if Surge is on cooldown for more than 30 seconds.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi windows.
Cast Arcane Barrage immediately if the Arcane Soul buff is active.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges if Touch of the Magi was recently applied or is about to expire.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges when the Arcane Salvo stack count reaches 25.
In AoE, cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges when Arcane Salvo reaches 6, 12, or 18 stacks to optimize Spellfire Sphere generation.
Spend Clearcasting procs on Arcane Missiles, prioritized during Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi windows.
Use Arcane Orb if you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges to rapidly generate charges.
Cast Arcane Pulse when facing 3 or more enemies if you have low Arcane Charges.
Use Arcane Explosion as a generator against 4 or more enemies if you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges (and do not have the Impetus talent).
Use Arcane Blast as your primary filler to build Arcane Charges when no other high-priority spells are available.
Cast Arcane Barrage to dump charges if the fight is about to end or as a movement filler.
